questions.question: Which instruction is used to store data from a register to a SRAM location pointed by an address register? Explain. / [CO2]

• Which instruction is used to store data from a register to a SRAM
  • location pointed by an address register? Explain.
  • The instruction used to store data from a register to an SRAM location
  • pointed by an address register in AVR microcontrollers is the ST (Store
  • Indirect) instruction.
  • ST:Stores data from a general-purpose register into the data memory
  • location pointed to by the X, Y, or Z register pair. For example,
  • ST Y+, R21 stores the value of register R21 into the memory location
  • pointed to by the Y register pair and then increments the Y register.
  • [K] / [CO2]

  • LDI R16,0x00 ; Clear R16 (will hold the LOW byte of the product)
  • LDI R17,0x00 ; Clear R17 (will hold the HIGH byte of the product)
  • LDS R0,0x60 ; Load first operand (multiplicand) from SRAM address 0x60
  • LDS R1,0x61 ; Load second operand (multiplier) from SRAM address 0x61
  • L2: ADD R16,R0 ; Add multiplicand (R0) to result low byte (R16)
  • BRCC L1 ; If no carry from ADD, skip increment of high byte
  • INC R17 ; If carry occurred, increment high byte (R17)
  • L1: DEC R1 ; Decrement multiplier (R1)
  • BRNE L2 ; Repeat loop until multiplier reaches zero
